segments.name: Products
segments.description: Networking equipment including high-speed Ethernet switches (7050X, 7060X, 7800R series), routers, and platforms for data center, AI, and campus networking. Built on Broadcom merchant silicon (Trident, Tomahawk) with proprietary EOS software.

segments.name: Services
segments.description: Software subscriptions, support, maintenance, and professional services. Includes CloudVision management platform, EOS software updates, and technical support contracts.

segments.name: AI Networking (sub-segment)
segments.description: AI back-end cluster networking including 800GbE switches, AI-specific load balancing, and AI network observability. Not separately reported but guided by management.
segments.note: Arista led branded market share for 800GbE and overall DC Ethernet switching

segments.name: Campus Networking (sub-segment)
segments.description: Enterprise campus networking solutions expanded via VeloCloud SD-WAN acquisition from Broadcom. Wi-Fi, wired access, and SD-WAN for enterprise edge.
segments.note: Acquired VeloCloud SD-WAN from Broadcom to accelerate campus entry

geographic_breakdown.note: Dominated by US hyperscaler customers; concentration increasing

supply_chain.concentration_risk: VERY HIGH - Microsoft (26%) + Meta (15%) = 41%+ of revenue from just 2 customers. Key risk: capex pause, white-boxing (in-house switch development), or vendor diversification by either customer could materially impact revenue. Broadcom silicon dependency adds supply-side concentration risk.

tam.data_center_ethernet_switch_2025: ~$60B+ (total Ethernet switch market grew 35.2% in Q3 2025)

industry_specific.ai_networking_tam: AI back-end networking shifting rapidly to Ethernet; over 2/3 of Q3 2025 switch sales in AI clusters were Ethernet (vs InfiniBand). 800GbE port shipments tripled sequentially in Q2 2025. Arista targets $2.75B-$3.25B AI networking revenue in 2026, implying ~$10B+ addressable AI networking market.
industry_specific.campus_networking_tam: Arista targeting $1.25B campus revenue in 2026 from ~$750-800M in 2025 (~60% growth). Enterprise campus networking is a multi-billion dollar market traditionally dominated by Cisco. VeloCloud SD-WAN acquisition extends Arista into WAN edge.
industry_specific.800gbe_leadership: Arista led branded market share for 800GbE in 2025. 800GbE port shipments more than tripled sequentially in Q2 2025.
industry_specific.eos_software_moat: Single unified OS (EOS) — Linux-based, state-sharing architecture. Enables hitless upgrades, deep telemetry, AI-native features. High switching costs once deployed in mission-critical DC environments. CloudVision management platform adds network-wide automation and observability.
